# Alejandro Buján

> Engineer from Melide (Galicia, Spain), based in San Francisco. AI Lead at Base10 Partners and Exponential-Barrié Fellow. Interested in intelligent technologies, computer graphics and entrepreneurship.

Site: https://alejandrobujan.com · Email: hi@alejandrobujan.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/alejandrobujan/ · GitHub: https://github.com/alejandrobujan · X: https://x.com/alejandr0bujan

## Now
- AI Lead at Base10 Partners (venture capital firm, San Francisco), May 2026 – present. Building AI-native tooling for venture investing workflows.
- Exponential-Barrié Fellow, 2026. The Exponential Fellowship (Fundación Barrié) is a high-performance excellence program that selects top STEM graduates and technical professionals in Spain and places them as engineers at top-tier Silicon Valley companies, with visa sponsorship. Evidence: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7500594634780295168/
- MS in Computer Science at Georgia Institute of Technology, specialization in Artificial Intelligence, 2026 – present (in parallel with the Base10 role).
- Creator of Tendedero, an open source macOS app launched in October 2026 (about 1 million views of the launch post, 1,500 GitHub stars in three days). https://tendedero.app

## Achievements, ordered by merit and difficulty

- The Exponential Fellowship (Fundación Barrié), 2026. Selective program for the top Spanish STEM talent; grants employment as an engineer at top-tier Silicon Valley companies.
- Fulbright Master's Scholarship, 2026, awarded and declined by choice. Highly competitive, merit-based funding granted by the Selection Committee on academic excellence, leadership potential and an impactful project (up to $45,000 per year plus insurance and travel).

- Extraordinary Bachelor's Degree Award, University of A Coruña, 2025. The highest possible university-wide distinction of each cohort, for the whole BEng in Computer Science.

## Projects
### Highlighted
- Tendedero (https://tendedero.app), October 2026. A free, open source macOS app that hangs every screenshot on a thin line just above the screen: rest the pointer in the menu bar and the line glides down; click to copy, hold to mark up, drag into any app or folder. Native Swift, AppKit and SwiftUI; signed and notarized by Apple; no network access. Launched on October 7, 2026: the launch post on X reached about 1 million views, 14,200 likes, 6,300 bookmarks and 1,200 reposts within three days, and the GitHub repository passed 1,500 stars and 120 forks in the same period. Five releases in four days, contributions and translations from the community, and a website that is itself a working demo in English, Spanish, French and Simplified Chinese. Source: https://github.com/alejandrobujan/tendedero · Launch post: https://x.com/alejandr0bujan/status/2107726966304690416 · Press kit: https://tendedero.app/press/ · Details for agents: https://tendedero.app/llms.txt

### Other projects
- ECHOLOOK (https://devpost.com/software/echolook), 2025. The AI-powered fitting room in your pocket: snap a photo, say what you want, and see Inditex styles on you in seconds. First Prize, InditexTech Track, HackUPC 2025.
- SPLALM (https://gitlab.lbd.org.es/alejandro.bujan.pampin/splalm). A tool designed to manage Software Product Lines and the development lifecycle of products generated from them.
- DBSW Battle Arena (https://github.com/alejandrobujan/dbsw-battle-arena · https://www.romhacking.net/hacks/10080/). Fan romhack of Dragon Ball Z: Supersonic Warriors 2 for Nintendo DS: a pure fighting version with new characters to unlock.
